metadata.title: A Complex Structure on $T^2\times S^4$: The Genus-One Case of Calabi's Problem
metadata.abstract: We construct a complex structure on $T^2\times S^4$, giving an affirmative answer to the genus-one case of Calabi's problem. The resulting compact complex threefold is non-Kähler and admits no biholomorphic product decomposition.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Calabi 问题的 genus-one complex structure
analysis.workSummary: 构造在 C* 上 period matrix 明确的 holomorphic complex-two-torus family，以两端 rank-one Tate 的 xy=q chart completion 和 holomorphic translation 拼成 compact threefold；光滑 gluing 先得 T²×Y，Y 为 smooth homotopy four-sphere，再用 Hirsch 稳定乘积定理得 T²×S⁴。holomorphic map 到 P¹ 的两个 critical locus 为 elliptic curve；该 smooth manifold 的任何 complex structure 均非 Kähler 且不为 nontrivial holomorphic product。
analysis.breakthrough: 若构造的可积性与全局识别成立，将填补经典 complex structure 问题。
analysis.limitations: T²×Y 的识别无需先证明 Y 标准，因此不解决 smooth 四维 Poincaré；构造也不依赖拟议 S⁶ complex structure。regular fibre 的 real torus splitting 不必 holomorphic，关键 analytic filling 与 boundary period gluing 需单独核验。
